json.text: Alright team, let's get this straight. [clears throat] The headline for the lead story needs more punch. "Local Council Meeting Concludes" isn't going to cut it. We're talking about a multi-million dollar budget approval, not a book club update. [short pause] And try to remember, "breaking news" means it's happening now, not yesterday. I know deadlines are tight, but accuracy still matters, even if the coffee machine is on the fritz again.
